title: Data Centres (SPICe Spotlight briefing)
notes: Covers Cato (280,000 m2, 35 m, 400-4,000 GWh/yr), Larbert (128,863 m2), Rufus (540 MW), Gogar (200 MW); Scotland generated 51.8 TWh in 2024 (91.5% renewable); cites APRS mapping of 26 proposals.

title: Data Centre Map (Scotland proposals tracker)
perspective: Campaign group advocating a moratorium; useful census but figures must be verified against planning records
notes: 26 projects with per-site pages linking planning documents. No downloadable dataset.

title: Proposed Data Centre Connection Reforms (consultation)
notes: Demand connection queue grew 41 GW to 125 GW (Nov 2024 - Jun 2025), ~80 GW attributed to data centres. Proposes commitment fee of GBP 237,500-712,500/MW. Closes 16 Sep 2026. Aggregate figures only; no project-level demand register.

title: Green Datacentres and Digital Connectivity: Vision and Action Plan for Scotland
perspective: Government strategy promoting Scotland as a data-hosting location

title: AI Growth Zones written statement HLWS1290 (Lanarkshire designation)
notes: Designates Lanarkshire AI Growth Zone centred on DataVita Chapelhall/Airdrie sites with CoreWeave anchor; 500 MW AI-ready capacity, >1 GW private-wire renewables, GBP 8.2bn claim.

title: Transmission Entry Capacity (TEC) Register
notes: CSV/API, updated twice weekly. Generation-focused; NESO confirmed via FOI that no public register of demand connections exists — the data-centre demand queue is not project-level public data.
